segments.speaker: odysseus
segments.caption: At your knees, lady — though I dare not touch them — tell me: are you goddess or mortal? Never have my eyes seen your like, and I have suffered: long days the sea broke over me, and I know not one soul in this land. Pity a stranger — grant me some cast rag to wear, and show me the way to your town.
segments.delivery: terrifying castaway silhouette controlled by diplomatic distance, lowered posture, and crafted praise

segments.speaker: nausicaa
segments.caption: Stranger, you seem neither base nor witless, and Zeus deals fortune as he wills — what he gives, a man must bear. But you have come to our land now, and you shall lack neither clothing nor anything owed a hard-tried suppliant. Stand, girls — this man is no enemy; wash him where the river gives shelter, and set food and oil beside him.
segments.delivery: initially startled but divinely steadied, listening alone while her companions scatter
